name: After § 15
title: REPORT on the annual report on the activities of the European Ombudsman in 2024
part_text: 15a. Warns against the phenomenon of ‘simulated transparency’, where institutions publish excessive quantities of secondary or technical material while delaying or restricting access to documents of primary relevance for democratic scrutiny, such as arrangements with governments or lobbyists on matters affecting the everyday lives of citizens; stresses that transparency must be substantive and effective, rather than merely formal or procedural;
